topic: Design Systems, Tokens, and Scalable UI Architecture
learningObjectives: Identify the core layers of a scalable design system.
Use design tokens to maintain visual consistency.
Structure reusable components for large interface projects.

activities.title: Design System Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the layers of a design system.

content.concept: A design system combines foundations, design tokens, components, patterns, guidelines, and documentation.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Token Matcher
activities.instruction: Match design tokens to their UI roles.

content.concept: Design tokens store reusable values such as colors, spacing, typography, radii, and shadows.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Token Scale Builder
activities.instruction: Build a consistent spacing and type scale.

content.concept: Consistent token scales help interfaces remain visually coherent as the product grows.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Component Architecture Lab
activities.instruction: Organize components into a scalable structure.

content.concept: A scalable component architecture separates foundations, reusable components, patterns, and page-level compositions.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
